acceptance: implementation candidate; done means its acceptance criteria and recorded evidence passed, not release, shipment, or compatibility certification

atoms.title: Package skeleton and real verifier
atoms.criterion: Swift package targets, mmctl placeholder, synthetic fixture boundary, and fast/full verification are green without importer logic.

atoms.title: Type-7 evidence decision
atoms.criterion: A read-only aggregate analysis records exactly what the eight observed type-7 rows prove and leaves semantics unknown where evidence is insufficient.

atoms.title: Budget period evidence decision
atoms.criterion: A read-only aggregate analysis records evidence and uncertainty for observed PERIOD_TYPE=6 without guessing a vendor label.

atoms.title: Source classifier and immutable reader
atoms.criterion: mmctl classifies supported/unknown/corrupt SQLite profiles read-only and proves before/after source hash equality.

atoms.title: Staging provenance and opaque sidecar
atoms.criterion: Every parsed source record/field receives deterministic provenance and unknown values round-trip through a bounded opaque sidecar.

atoms.title: Loss report and reconciliation
atoms.criterion: Every staged source entity is deterministically mapped, sidecar-preserved, intentionally excluded with reason, or blocking; expect-zero-loss fails otherwise.

atoms.title: Canonical money and temporal primitives
atoms.criterion: Canonical primitives preserve exact amount/currency/raw literal and UTC/local-date/timezone semantics without binary floating point.

atoms.title: Atomic idempotent canonical commit
atoms.criterion: A staged import atomically commits or leaves canonical state unchanged, and repeated identical imports create no duplicate economic event.

atoms.title: Canonical store v11 foundation (issue 33)
atoms.criterion: Canonical store v11 migration machinery exists: frozen legacy fingerprints, explicit ALTER statement arrays executed by ensureSchema, and an upgrade test from a pinned v10 fixture; command-layer typed error cases replace the incompatibleCanonicalStore collapse; export packages carry an independent format version whose decode accepts older packages.

atoms.title: Security and app lock (issue 26)
atoms.criterion: Passcode/biometric lock with keychain-held secret; escalating lockout persisted in the keychain at five attempts to one minute and ten attempts to fifteen minutes, surviving restart; encrypted backup packages open by decrypt-to-memory feeding applyExport through the pinned writer, never whole-file replacement; restore rejects tampered payloads; biometric failure falls back to passcode.

atoms.title: Account lifecycle and totals flags (issue 27)
atoms.criterion: Account update/tombstone commands; include-in-totals and hidden flags stored as columns and honored deterministically: totals exclude hidden accounts, reports and search expose both flags as filters; loan/overdraft/investment variants land as a new variant column with named migration statements, never CHECK widening.

atoms.title: Category editors and hierarchy (issue 28)
atoms.criterion: Category rename/reorder/hide commands with explicit ordinal ordering; optional parent reference with application-level cycle detection inside mutate producing a named cycle-detected error; rollup aggregates child activity without double counting and excludes tombstoned or hidden branches; observed-v19 parent references map only after PAR-007 oracle evidence lands.

atoms.title: Locale presentation layer (issue 29)
atoms.criterion: Locale-aware money and date rendering over canonical ExactDecimal and SourceTemporal values; formatted strings are never re-parsed into canonical truth; transaction entry parses amounts with a fixed invariant formatter at the trust boundary so locale decimal separators cannot corrupt literals.

atoms.title: Import and backup format breadth (issue 30)
atoms.criterion: Registered compatibility profiles for legacy Android names, iOS sqlite classification, Excel/TSV import, legacy xls, and a vendor round-trip writer inside the adapter boundary; complete and contents-only reset implemented as create-new-ledger plus atomic rename owned by the descriptor-bound boundary; each format certifies independently through the registry, and formats without fixtures stay classification-only and visibly blocking.

atoms.title: Product polish batch (issue 31)
atoms.criterion: Light theme through asset-catalog appearance variants with a settings override; reminders scheduled only through user-granted UNUserNotificationCenter authorization; a widget-class surface on macOS where the system supports widgets; every new surface exposes VoiceOver row navigation rather than monolithic text blobs.

atoms.title: Device and oracle actions, human-supervised (issue 32)
atoms.criterion: Human-executed evidence collection: photo byte export, type-7 device action, original-app oracles for SMS/macros/ZETC/CODE_DATA and PERIOD_TYPE=6; each action lands as immutable corpus evidence plus a synthetic fixture pair under fixtures/synthetic/.
